confidence_notes: Food and drink estimates use Taormina cost-of-living reports cross-checked against local menus. Cocktail and wine estimates reflect local menu prices relative to draft beer. Lodging values are holistic estimates with substantial seasonal and property-type uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: No outside city comparator used; food and drink rely on Taormina price data, while lodging reflects its premium, highly seasonal Sicilian resort market.
